title: WORLD'S BEST AIR FRIES (Weird Trick, But It Works!)
summary: Chef Chris Young shows a simplified triple-cooked method for making crisp frozen fries in an air fryer, based on Heston Blumenthal's technique.
why: Cited as proof that frozen fries can be excellent with the right cooking method.
